item.title: Jolly Neil DeGrasse Tyson Going Down People's Chimneys And Telling Kids Santa Isn't Real
item.description: KNOXVILLE, TN — It's that time of year again, when astrophysicist Neil DeGrasse Tyson renews his annual tradition of going down people's chimneys to tell their kids that Santa isn't real.

item.title: Uh Oh: Wife Actually DID Want Something For Christmas
item.description: U.S. — What had been a joyous holiday threatened to be thrown into panic, as urgent reports began trickling in that, despite her repeated statements to the contrary over the last month, your wife actually did want something for Christmas.

item.title: Person Who Apparently Hates You Got Your Kid A Recorder
item.description: SAN CARLOS, CA — A person who apparently hates you got your kid a recorder for Christmas.
